title: EXACT coerces numbers, logicals, and blanks to text before comparing exact UTF-16 code units without case folding or Unicode normalization
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, EXACT(text1, text2) converts both operands with worksheet text coercion (so EXACT(123,"123"), EXACT(TRUE,"TRUE"), and EXACT(blank,"") are TRUE) and tests exact UTF-16 code-unit sequence equality without case folding (EXACT("abc","ABC") -> FALSE), without Unicode normalization or German sharp-s equivalence (EXACT("ß","ss") -> FALSE), and keeping supplementary surrogate pairs intact. All 2,856 full-bank EXACT rows match.
basis: Measured in DnaCalc jnt_text_formats rows 79-86, jnt_logical_info rows 171-173, and dcfl2_text row 16 (Excel 16.0.20527.20088); 2,856/2,856 full-bank rows match.
